`analyzeLandscape` now works as a second name for `updateLandscape`. It compiles cleanly, but I didn't run any tests or try the new command.

- **`cli/.../CommandLineInterface.java`**: the dispatch in `run` sends both names to the same `updateLandscape` method, so the options are identical. Under `-help`, `analyzeLandscape` prints its own usage and `updateLandscape` still prints its own.
- **`cli/.../Commands.java`**: I added the `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` name and description. The description calls it the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and says it is the same as `updateLandscape`. `analyzeLandscape` is also in the no-argument usage overview.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions at all, so I added a short "Landscape" section. It shows `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>`, says `updateLandscape` still works, and says both create `_sokrates_landscape/config.json` and `index.html`.

I haven't committed anything.
